blocks.text: 1964 mein M. Gell-Mann aur George Zweig ne tajweez kiya ke koi bhi hadron, proton aur neutron bhi, sach mein bunyadi nahi, balke teen aur bunyadi cheezon ke mel se bana hai jinhein quarks ya quark flavours kehte hain. Quarks leptons ki tarah sach mein bunyadi zarre mane jate hain. Shuru ke teen quarks ke naam up, down aur strange the (alamat u, d, s). Aaj hum chhe quarks jante hain, jaise chhe leptons hain; fitrat mein ek farz ki hui symmetry (barabari) ki bunyad par. Baqi teen charm, bottom aur top (c, b, t) hain (Table 12.4). Har quark ka spin aur electric charge hai, aur yeh charge electron ke charge e ka ek hissa (fraction, jaise 2/3 ya 1/3) hai, jise pehle sab se chhota charge samjha jata tha. Quarks nazar nahi aate; yeh kabhi akele nahi milte.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Table 12.4 mein anti-up quark ko 'm̄' likhti hai; yeh chhapai ki ghalti hai. Sahi alamat ū (anti-up) hai, charge −2/3.

Tamam hadrons quarks ke mel se bane hain (aur gluons unhein jore rakhte hain), aur un ki khususiyat un ke quarks dekh kar samjhi jati hain. Mesons ek quark aur ek antiquark ka jora hain. Maslan π⁺ meson u aur d̄ (up aur anti-down) se bana hai, aur π⁰ u aur ū se ban sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab π⁺ ko 'ud combination' likhti hai. Sahi ud̄ hai (up quark + anti-down quark): charge +2/3 + 1/3 = +1. Kitab khud aage yahi likhti hai. u aur d ka charge to +2/3 − 1/3 = +1/3 hota.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab proton ki banawat 'ud' aur us ke jor ko 'q(udd)' likhti hai. Proton mein teen quarks hain: uud. Jor 2/3 + 2/3 − 1/3 = +1 bhi uud ka hi hai; udd to neutron hai.
Neutron ki quark banawat udd hai (ek up, do down), aur charge quantum number:

blocks.caption: Proton (uud) aur neutron (udd) ki quark banawat (kitab mein Table 12.4 ke saath bane be-unwan khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har quark ka charge jor kar dekhein: up quark (u) +2/3 aur down quark (d) −1/3. Proton = u + u + d = 2/3 + 2/3 − 1/3 = +1. Neutron = u + d + d = 2/3 − 1/3 − 1/3 = 0. Kitab ki tasveer mein quarks ke harf bohat chhote chhape hain, is liye yahan text ke mutabiq proton mein u, u, d aur neutron mein u, d, d likhe gaye hain.

Mesons quark-antiquark jore hain. π⁺ meson lein: is mein up quark u aur antidown quark d̄ hai. Up quark ka charge +2/3 aur antidown ka +1/3 hai (down ke −1/3 ka ulta). Jor +1 banta hai: q = 2/3 + 1/3 = +1, jo π⁺ ka charge hai.

Quark theory ke kuch hi baad kaha gaya ke quarks ki ek aur khasiyat hai jise colour ya “colour charge” kehte hain (electric charge jaisi). Is theory ke mutabiq har flavour ka quark teen colours mein se ek rakh sakta hai: red, green ya blue. Yaad rahe “colour” aur “flavour” ka hamare hawaas (dekhne, chakhne) se koi talluq nahi; yeh sirf shauqiya naam hain, jaise charm. Antiquarks ke colours antired, antigreen aur antiblue hain. Baryon teen quarks se bana hai, har colour ka ek. Meson ek colour aur us ke anticolour wale quark-antiquark ka jora hai. Is tarah baryons aur mesons dono colourless (be-rang), yani 'white', hain. Har quark par colour charge hai, aur quarks ke darmiyan strong force ko colour force kehte hain. Strong force ki is theory ko quantum chromodynamics (QCD) kehte hain, kyunke yeh force colour charges ke darmiyan lagti hai (electric charges ke darmiyan nahi). Do hadrons ke darmiyan strong force asal mein un ke quarks ke darmiyan ki force hai.

blocks.alt: Teen bare daire. (a) Proton aur Neutron: har ek mein teen quarks, ek neela, ek surkh aur ek hara; proton mein u, d aur u, neutron mein u, d aur d. (b) Antiproton: teen antiquarks, anti-u peela (antiblue), anti-u magenta (antigreen) aur anti-d cyan (antired).
blocks.caption: Figure 12.7: (a) Be-rang (colourless) baryons: neela + surkh + hara = safed; (b) Be-rang antibaryon: antiblue + antired + antigreen = safed (kitab ki Figure 12.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har baryon mein teen quarks hain aur har quark ka 'colour' alag hai: ek surkh, ek hara, ek neela. Teeno mil kar 'safed' yaani be-rang (colourless) ho jate hain, jaise roshni ke teen bunyadi rang mil kar safed roshni banate hain. Antiproton ke antiquarks ulte rang (anticolours) rakhte hain: antiblue ko peela, antigreen ko magenta aur antired ko cyan dikhaya gaya hai; yeh teeno bhi mil kar safed hain. Yaad rahe ke yeh 'colour' asal rang nahi, sirf quarks ki ek khasiyat (colour charge) ka naam hai.
Beta Decay in Terms of Quarks
Jab nucleus mein neutron toot kar proton aur electron (beta particle) banta hai, to saath ek antineutrino bhi banta hai:
Ab hum dekh sakte hain ke udd wala neutron uud wala proton ban jata hai jab us ka ek down quark up quark mein badal jata hai. Asal bunyadi amal yeh hai:

blocks.title: Do you know?
blocks.text: Neutron sirf nucleus ke andar stable hai. Azaad (free) neutrons decay ho jate hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab azaad neutron ki half-life 900 s likhti hai. Sahi half-life taqreeban 610 s (taqreeban 10 minute) hai; taqreeban 880 s (taqreeban 15 minute) us ki ausat umar (mean lifetime) hai, half-life nahi.

Is tarah maadde ki bunyadi fitrat ki samajh jitni gehri hoti hai, hum jaane pehchane amal (jaise beta decay) ko utni hi bareek satah par samajh sakte hain. Quark model zarron ki banawat bhi samjhata hai aur un ke aapas ke asar bhi.

blocks.prompt: Quark banawat ke lihaz se protons aur neutrons bayan kijiye (comprehensive question 12.6). Proton aur neutron ek doosre mein kaise badalte hain (short question 12.10)?
blocks.explanation: Proton: do up quarks aur ek down quark, uud, charge 2/3 + 2/3 - 1/3 = +1. Neutron: ek up aur do down quarks, udd, charge 2/3 - 1/3 - 1/3 = 0; har ek mein teen quarks teen rang rakhte hain, to zarra be-rang hai. Beta-minus decay mein down quark up quark banta hai (d → u + e⁻ + ν̄), jis se neutron proton banta hai; beta-plus decay mein up quark down quark banta hai (u → d + e⁺ + ν), jis se proton neutron banta hai.

items: Gell-Mann aur Zweig (1964): hadrons quarks se bane hain, jo kabhi akele nahi milte. Chhe flavours: u (+2/3), d (−1/3), c (+2/3), s (−1/3), t (+2/3), b (−1/3); antiquarks ulte charge ke saath (Table 12.4).
Baryons: teen quarks (proton uud, +1; neutron udd, 0). Mesons: quark + antiquark (π⁺ = ud̄). Colours: red, green, blue; hadrons colourless; colour force, QCD. Beta decay: d → u + e⁻ + ν̄.
